scope_notes: All four isolated branches start at baseline b12f0f8760a3e88e9539b0c8cfd32b38a5297c68 and extract exactly one value-backed field from the combined candidate.
Deposit isolates Deposit.liquidity; gross isolates Tick.stakedLiquidityGross; delta isolates Tick.stakedLiquidityDelta; incentive isolates ExternalIncentive.rewardPerSecondX128.

Each isolated value keeps its pointer-compatible getter/setter signatures, presence flag, constructor behavior, clone behavior, and detached-copy semantics; unrelated numeric fields remain pointer-backed.
The immutable combined candidate cc1dacdb86b6cbfcc6ea215626a336ff83bb3b0d is included for attribution only; its correctness tests were already reported passing and are not rerun by Main.

The shared public fixture preserves deposit, signed tick-crossing, and incentive create/claim/end scenarios while measuring each of 33 stake allocations, each of 33 unstakes, and repeated paid external claims as separate metric windows.

Fixture clocks and state assertions are outside metric windows; warmup template and a 1% unstaking fee are configured explicitly, and final assertions require zero active deposits, reward entitlements, and staked tick liquidity while historical records may persist.
